deployments.notes: Date approximate — press coverage of Sainsbury's Facewatch rollout to 5 London stores published 2022. Facewatch describes itself as UK retail's 'biggest and only legally-compliant Live Facial Recognition system'.

One of five Sainsbury's London stores in initial Facewatch rollout. Feb 2026 incident: Warren Rajah misidentified and ejected by staff acting on Facewatch alert. Sainsbury's apologised, attributed error to 'human staff error not system failure', offered £75 voucher. Reported in Guardian (5 Feb 2026): https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/feb/05/london-man-sainsburys-facial-recognition-facewatch

Date corrected 2026-09-06 from the generic 2022 rollout placeholder (see priv-001) -- that date was never specific to this store. Jared confirmed in person that Facewatch FRS was operating at this store, and was told it began in January (2026-07-27 note); a separate capture independently describes the same store's system running at least February-May 2026 (queue item closed on this correction). source_type has no clean enum value for first-hand personal observation -- flagging as a schema gap rather than forcing it into news_report, which is what the old citation supports (the general 2022 rollout) and does not actually support this date.
